accepted: after cursor keeps instance/epoch/feed/source cursor identity
heartbeat and terminal frames remain visible and bounded
a recovery subscription keeps a bounded merge window until the fresh snapshot boundary
the merge window keeps the event id memory so a re-published event is a replay, not a second item
a merged terminal stays visible to the surface and later deltas stay late updates
denied: delta before snapshot boundary, old epoch, instance drift or sequence gap
late terminal update, disposed subscription, second broadcast bus or direct effect
foreign run payload rendered or merged into another run's cursor
merge window overflow merged partially instead of failing closed
terminal loss without the explicit query alarm
